caption:
The head of Instagram said both of these. Both are true.

"Follower counts matter less than view and like counts."

"Follower count is super important, because you have a much better chance of reaching anybody who follows you than anyone who does not."

Adam Mosseri, 2024.

They only look contradictory. Followers are not a ranking input, so buying them buys you no distribution. But connected reach — your own followers — is far easier to earn than unconnected reach. So followers act as a floor under your views, not as a lever on them.

Which is exactly why buying followers backfires. You get a bigger floor made of people who never watch, your engagement rate falls, and the engagement rate is the actual input.

That is the mechanism behind "my reach died right after I bought followers". It was not a shadowban. It was arithmetic.

Sources: Mosseri on Threads, April 2024; Mosseri in interview with Colin and Samir, 2024.
